questions.question_english: In the context of the Kothari Commission's structural recommendations, what did the "+2" stage specifically represent?
options_english: Two years of compulsory pre-primary education focusing on foundational literacy skills
Two years of higher secondary education featuring general academic and vocational streams
Two years of undergraduate foundation courses prior to entering specialized degree programs
Two years of compulsory national social service prior to joining university programs

questions.question_english: Prior to 1976, Education was predominantly placed in which list of the Seventh Schedule?
options_english: Union List
State List
Concurrent List
Residuary List
questions.explanation_english: State List Prior to the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976, education was listed under List II (State List) of the Seventh Schedule. Consequently, primary administrative and legislative authority over school and university education rested almost exclusively with individual State governments.
questions.explanation_hindi: 42वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1976 से पहले शिक्षा मुख्यतः सातवीं अनुसूची की सूची II, अर्थात राज्य सूची में थी। इसलिए विद्यालयी और विश्वविद्यालयी शिक्षा पर प्राथमिक विधायी तथा प्रशासनिक अधिकार राज्यों के पास था। 1976 में शिक्षा को समवर्ती सूची में स्थानांतरित किए जाने से केंद्र और राज्यों दोनों को इस विषय पर कानून बनाने का अधिकार मिला।

questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित दो कथनों पर विचार कीजिए। एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) कहा गया है।
अभिकथन (A): वैश्विक प्रतिस्पर्धा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए NEP 2020 कक्षा 1 से अंग्रेज़ी को शिक्षण का अनिवार्य माध्यम बनाती है।
कारण (R): शोध से पता चलता है कि छोटे बच्चे अपनी घरेलू भाषा या मातृभाषा में जटिल अवधारणाएँ अधिक तेजी और गहराई से समझते हैं।
सही विकल्प चुनिए।
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सही हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है।
A और R दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता।
A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है।
A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है।
questions.source: Pinepage, UPSC Principal & Vice Principal Volume 4, Chapter 1 (National Education Policy), Question 67; answer/explanation section in same chapter

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): NEP 2020 mandates that the medium of instruction must be English from Grade 1 to ensure global competitiveness.
Reason (R): Research shows that young children learn and grasp non-trivial concepts most quickly in their home language/mother tongue.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: A is false but R is true Research confirms that young children grasp complex concepts most effectively when taught in their home language or mother tongue. Consequently, the policy advocates instructing in local languages during early grades rather than mandating English medium instruction, making early concept acquisition smoother and culturally grounded for young learners.
questions.explanation_hindi: NEP 2020 कक्षा 1 से अंग्रेज़ी को अनिवार्य शिक्षण-माध्यम बनाने की बात नहीं करती। इसके विपरीत, नीति जहाँ संभव हो, शुरुआती कक्षाओं में घरेलू भाषा, मातृभाषा, स्थानीय या क्षेत्रीय भाषा के उपयोग का समर्थन करती है, क्योंकि छोटे बच्चे परिचित भाषा में अवधारणाएँ बेहतर समझ सकते हैं। इसलिए अभिकथन गलत है और कारण सही है।
questions.topic: National Education Policy and related educational-policy questions
key_facts: A is false but R is true

A is false but R is true Research confirms that young children grasp complex concepts most effectively when taught in their home language or mother tongue. Consequently, the policy advocates instructing in local languages during early grades rather than mandating English medium instruction, making early concept acquisition smoother and culturally grounded for young learners.

रिपोर्ट कार्ड बनाना अधिक तकनीकी और प्रशासनिक रूप से जटिल बनाना।

questions.question_english: A Principal decides to shift the school's assessment policy from raw marks to a 9-point absolute grading scale for middle school. This decision is most directly supported by which educational objective?
options_english: To reduce student misclassification caused by numerical mark variations
To deliberately increase fierce and unhealthy competition among students for top class ranks
To classify and group students into extremely narrow and rigid hierarchical academic categories
To administrative staff and teachers by complicating the technical preparation of report cards
questions.explanation_english: To reduce student misclassification caused by numerical mark variations Replacing exact raw marks with broad letter grade bands minimizes measurement errors and reduces artificial misclassification of student capability. Small numerical mark differences

questions.question_english: Under the RTE Act, 2009, what is the mandated Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) for primary classes (Classes I to V) if the total number of admitted children is up to 120?
questions.explanation_english: 1:30 Under the statutory schedule of the RTE Act 2009, the mandated Pupil-Teacher Ratio for primary grades (Classes 1 to 5) is 1:30 for schools with total enrollment up to 120 students. questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): In competency-based assessment, the focus shifts from rote memorization to the application of knowledge in real-life situations.
Reason (R): Competency-based assessment evaluates students solely against a norm- referenced group to rank them for competitive exams.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: A is true but R is false Competency-based assessment focuses on applying knowledge and skills in practical contexts rather than relying on rote memorization. It evaluates performance against explicit criterion- referenced mastery standards rather than norm- referenced peer rankings.

questions.question_english: Which statement about the ‘Artist(s)-in-Residence’ proposal is consistent with NEP 2020?

Every higher education institution and even every school or school complex will aim to have artists in residence to expose learners to art and regional/national heritage.
Artist-in-Residence is restricted to private art colleges.
Only digital recordings of artists may be used; no direct engagement is envisaged.
questions.explanation_english: The policy describes artists-in-residence as a way to expose learners to creativity and regional/country heritage.
questions.explanation_hindi: नीति कलाकार-इन-रेज़िडेंस को विद्यार्थियों को रचनात्मकता और क्षेत्रीय/राष्ट्रीय विरासत से परिचित कराने का उपाय बताती है।

questions.question_hindi:
शिक्षण-माध्यम पर कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. NEP जहाँ तक संभव हो, कम-से-कम कक्षा 5 तक घर/मातृ/स्थानीय/क्षेत्रीय भाषा की सिफारिश करती है।
2. जहाँ तक संभव हो, इसे कक्षा 8 और आगे तक जारी रखने को प्राथमिकता देती है।
3. प्रत्येक राज्य में संदर्भ की परवाह किए बिना एक ही भाषा अनिवार्य करती है।
सही कथन कौन-से हैं?

केवल 1 और 2।
केवल 2 और 3।

questions.question_english:
Consider statements about the medium of instruction:
1. NEP recommends the home/mother/local/regional language wherever possible until at least Grade 5.
2. It prefers continuing this till Grade 8 and beyond, wherever possible.
3. It requires every State to use one identical language regardless of context.
Which statements are correct?
options_english: 1 only.
1 and 2 only.
2 and 3 only.
questions.explanation_english: The policy uses ‘wherever possible’ and prefers continuation till Grade 8 and beyond; it does not impose one language on every State.

questions.topic: NEP 2020
key_facts: Wherever possible, the medium of instruction until at least Grade 5, but preferably till Grade 8 and beyond, will be the home language/mother tongue/local language/regional language.

questions.question_english: The pedagogical approach in the Preparatory Stage transitions from purely play-based to:
options_english: Rigid, teacher-centric lecture-based formal instruction
Complete self-directed learning operating without any teacher intervention
Discovery and activity-based classroom learning
Heavy reliance on standardized written testing and rote memorization
questions.explanation_english: Discovery and activity-based classroom learning Moving from early childhood play practices, the Preparatory Stage transitions toward activity- based, interactive, and discovery-driven learning methods. This stage introduces foundational reading, writing, mathematics, physical education, art, and science concepts through engaging classroom activities, building curiosity and basic analytical thinking without relying on rigid lecture-driven instruction.

questions.question_hindi: सामान्य प्रायिकता वक्र (Normal Probability Curve—NPC) में माध्य से −1 मानक विचलन और +1 मानक विचलन के बीच कितने प्रतिशत प्रेक्षण आते हैं?
options_hindi: लगभग 34.13%
लगभग 68.26%
लगभग 95.44%
लगभग 99.73%

questions.question_english: In a Normal Probability Curve (NPC), what percentage of cases fall between -1 Standard Deviation and +1 Standard Deviation from the mean?
options_english: Approximately 34.13%
Approximately 68.26%
Approximately 95.44%
Approximately 99.73%
questions.explanation_english: Approximately 68.26% Within a theoretical Normal Probability Curve, approximately 68.26 percent of the total distribution area falls within one standard deviation above and below the mean. questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) पर विचार कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A): वैध परीक्षा सामान्यतः विश्वसनीय होती है, लेकिन विश्वसनीय परीक्षा का वैध होना आवश्यक नहीं है।
कारण (R): कोई परीक्षा किसी विशेष गुण को लगातार माप सकती है, फिर भी संभव है कि वह उस गुण को न मापे जिसे मापने के लिए उसे बनाया गया था।
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सही हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है।
A और R दोनों सही हैं, किंतु R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
A सही है, किंतु R गलत है।
A गलत है, किंतु R सही है।
questions.source: Pinepage, UPSC Principal & Vice Principal Volume 4, Chapter 1 (National Education Policy), Question 102; answer/explanation section in same chapter

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): A valid test is generally reliable, but a reliable test is not necessarily valid.
Reason (R): A test may consistently measure an attribute (reliability) without measuring the specific attribute it was intended to measure (validity).
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A A valid test inherently demonstrates reliability because accurate measurement requires consistent results. However, a test can yield highly reliable, consistent scores over time while measuring the wrong variable, proving that score stability alone does not guarantee that the test measures its intended educational objective.
questions.explanation_hindi: अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सही हैं। वैध मापन में परिणामों की निरंतरता आवश्यक होती है, इसलिए वैध परीक्षा सामान्यतः विश्वसनीय भी होती है। इसके विपरीत, कोई परीक्षा बार-बार लगभग समान अंक दे सकती है, पर वह इच्छित ज्ञान या कौशल के बजाय किसी दूसरे गुण को माप रही हो सकती है। इसलिए विश्वसनीयता अपने आप वैधता की गारंटी नहीं देती और कारण, अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है।

key_facts: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

questions.question_hindi: CCE के संदर्भ में “व्यापक” (Comprehensive) का क्या अर्थ है?
options_hindi: निर्धारित मुख्य पाठ्यक्रम से बाहर के अप्रत्याशित प्रश्नों को व्यवस्थित रूप से शामिल करना।
शैक्षिक तथा सह-शैक्षिक क्षेत्रों में विकास का मूल्यांकन करना।
एक ही लंबी परीक्षा में सभी शैक्षणिक विषयों की परीक्षा एक साथ लेना।
परीक्षा से पहले सभी विद्यार्थियों को विस्तृत लिखित पुनरावृत्ति नोट्स देना।
questions.source: Pinepage, UPSC Principal & Vice Principal Volume 4, Chapter 1 (National Education Policy), Question 113; answer/explanation section in same chapter

questions.question_english: In the context of CCE, "Comprehensive" implies:
options_english: Systematically including unexpected examination questions from outside the prescribed core syllabus
Evaluating both scholastic and co-scholastic areas of growth
Testing students simultaneously on all academic subjects during a single marathon examination day
Providing comprehensive, highly detailed written revision notes to all students prior to tests
questions.explanation_english: Evaluating both scholastic and co-scholastic areas of growth The "Comprehensive" component of CCE emphasizes evaluating all dimensions of student development. Beyond traditional academic subjects in scholastic areas, it systematically evaluates co-scholastic domains, including life skills, co-curricular activities, physical education, values, attitudes, and emotional growth, reflecting a well-rounded evaluation of learner development.
questions.explanation_hindi: CCE का “व्यापक” पक्ष विद्यार्थी के विकास के सभी प्रासंगिक आयामों को देखता है। इसमें पारंपरिक शैक्षणिक विषयों के साथ जीवन-कौशल, सह-पाठ्यचर्या गतिविधियाँ, शारीरिक शिक्षा, मूल्य, अभिवृत्तियाँ और भावनात्मक विकास भी शामिल हैं। इसका उद्देश्य केवल विषयों में अंक दर्ज करना नहीं, बल्कि विद्यार्थी की समग्र प्रगति की तस्वीर प्राप्त करना है।

Evaluating both scholastic and co-scholastic areas of growth The "Comprehensive" component of CCE emphasizes evaluating all dimensions of student development. Beyond traditional academic subjects in scholastic areas, it systematically evaluates co-scholastic domains, including life skills, co-curricular activities, physical education, values, attitudes, and emotional growth, reflecting a well-rounded evaluation of learner development.
